newsitem.title: GERMANY: German police hunt Vietnamese kidnappers.
newsitem.headline: German police hunt Vietnamese kidnappers.

text.p: German police were hunting 10 armed Vietnamese who stormed into a house in the western town of Neuss early on Tuesday and kidnapped three Laotians.
The gang initially seized all eight Laotian family members in the house and demanded a ransom of tens of thousands of marks.

One of the captives phoned a relative who alerted the police, but the kidnappers managed to flee with three hostages -- a 30-year-old man, a 36-year-old woman and a five-year-old girl -- before police surrounded the house.
Although a large contingent of police sealed off the area, the Vietnamese escaped without trace, taking their three hostages with them, police said.
One woman was slightly injured in the raid. It was not clear what sort of weapons the gang was using.
